claims.text: Still hypoxemic despite appropriate PAP use (up to 50% of cases): add O2;
claims.quote: This therapy is necessary for patients with OHS who remain hypoxemic despite appropriate PAP use—a situation reported in up to 50% of cases.

claims.text: O2 alone without PAP is strongly discouraged (doesn't improve ventilation; worsening CO2 retention).
claims.quote: Oxygen therapy alone, without PAP, is strongly discouraged, as it does not improve ventilation and may have poor outcomes with worsening CO2 retention.
